what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] OOS-only regression target routes non-empty oos.md through zero-findings branch
scenario_or_breakage: emit_zero_findings_branch snapshots and restores OOS state, and only copies rejected findings to the parent. If the plan is implemented literally so OOS-only output becomes zero-findings, parseable OOS observations can complete but vanish from accepted-OOS handoff instead of flowing to OOS filing/logs.
suggested_fix: Keep non-empty OOS output on the existing aggregation/tally OOS path. Minimum change: change the planned test to assert non-stall completion and bypass diagnostics, not REVIEW_CORE_STATUS=zero-findings, unless the zero-findings branch is also updated to preserve accepted OOS artifacts.
